Research approaches to give LLMs long-term memory that feels like it's in-context (not RAG chunks but coherent recall). Research: MemGPT/Lettuce (OS-level memory), MemWalker, MemoryBank, RAPTOR, Infini-Attention, MiMoCode's existing memory system, any approaches for 'unlimited context' on consumer hardware. Focus on practical architectures that work on weak hardware (8-16GB RAM, CPU-only). How does MiMoCode's FTS5 memory work? Is there a better approach for cohesive memory? Search the web and read documentation/papers.
